join hortbot 2 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add pan FOUND THE (_PARAMETER_), HAVE YE?
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!pan working command
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FOUND THE working command, HAVE YE?

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!pan working command; something
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FOUND THE working command, HAVE YE?


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add pan FOUND THE (_PARAMETER_CAPS_), HAVE YE?
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!pan working command
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FOUND THE WORKING COMMAND, HAVE YE?

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!pan working command; something
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FOUND THE WORKING COMMAND, HAVE YE?


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add wow wow (_PARAMETER_), that's a cool (_PARAMETER_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!wow foo bar
send hortbot #foobar [HB] wow foo bar, that's a cool foo bar

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!wow foo bar ; somethingrather
send hortbot #foobar [HB] wow foo bar, that's a cool somethingrather

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!wow foo bar ; somethingrather ;    
send hortbot #foobar [HB] wow foo bar, that's a cool somethingrather


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add pan FOUND THE (_P_), HAVE YE?
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!pan working command
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FOUND THE working command, HAVE YE?

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!pan working command; something
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FOUND THE working command, HAVE YE?

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add pan FOUND THE (_P_CAPS_), HAVE YE?
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!pan working command
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FOUND THE WORKING COMMAND, HAVE YE?

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!pan working command; something
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FOUND THE WORKING COMMAND, HAVE YE?


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add indexed "(_PARAMETER_1_)" "(_P_1_)" "(_PARAMETER_2_)" "(_PARAMETER_0_)" "(_P_-1_)" "(_P_99_)"
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!indexed foo bar ; CooL
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "foo bar" "foo bar" "CooL" "(_PARAMETER_0_)" "(_P_-1_)" ""

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add indexed "(_PARAMETER_1_CAPS_)" "(_P_1_CAPS_)" "(_PARAMETER_2_CAPS_)" "(_PARAMETER_0_CAPS_)" "(_P_-1_CAPS_)" "(_P_99_CAPS_)"
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!indexed foo bar ; CooL
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "FOO BAR" "FOO BAR" "COOL" "(_PARAMETER_0_CAPS_)" "(_P_-1_CAPS_)" ""
